answer: Trust travels one hop at a time. Each wallet's standing is woven from a thread of endorsements, and every link had to be earned through real, reciprocal dealings over months. Carved links stay warm like jade; a forged chain feels like tundra — broad, cold, and empty of life. A cloned army can mint addresses instantly, but no script manufactures the shared history behind each edge: per link the price is years of behavior, paid separately, every time.
